method: Hand-calculated from labels.json, frozen responses, deterministic referral rules and v1 metric definitions. Source observations follow v1 field structure; each declared v2 row-field value and cardinality is counted under rows. Rates are rounded to four decimals. No replay evaluation code was run.

not_run.live: NOT_RUN: no live model or indexer calls
not_run.runner: NOT_RUN: expected values authored independently of the replay runner

wilson.independence_assumption: Cases are counted independently; paired identical-input variants share a family dedup key, so pooled intervals are optimistic.
